title: IRMSD: Integrated Risk Management for Software Development — Replication Package
description: Initial reproducibility release for the IRMSD framework. The GitHub repository contains a prototype backend and automated regression tests, sprint telemetry template and analysis scripts, documentation, and a clearly labelled 72-row synthetic sprint dataset with diagnostic outputs. The synthetic observations are pipeline-check materials and not field-trial evidence. The expert-adjudicated benchmark, comparative classifier evaluation, and real-team field-study materials are not included in this release.
notes: Provisional metadata. Confirm all creators, author order, affiliations, ORCID identifiers, copyright ownership, software license, and dataset redistribution permissions before releasing through Zenodo. This GitHub repository is populated with an initial technical scaffold, prototype source and tests, sprint-pilot scripts, and synthetic-only data/results. The benchmark and field-study materials remain incomplete. No Zenodo record or DOI has been created.
